subject: policy.standard

entries.definition: The single rules-first governance definition for one named subject, covering definition, scope, classifications, rules, lifecycle, representation, linked processes, change control, and history without becoming runtime authority.
The one explicitly identified record type, concept, or mechanism governed by a policy standard.
The representation layer of a policy standard: its documented fields and constraints, audited against a separately configured live schema rather than treated as provider truth.

limitations: This vocabulary defines portable policy meaning only; it does not create a policy instance, choose rules, approve proposals, audit a live schema, publish material, or grant execution authority.
Provider and policy projections must bind this exact artifact and fail visibly on drift; copied definitions never become canonical.
